# Rasheed Clothing International

> Rasheed Clothing International is a clothing manufacturer and exporter based in Sialkot, Pakistan, founded in 2017. We produce custom hoodies, streetwear, activewear, tracksuits, outerwear, gymwear and corporate uniforms for brands in Asia, the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, UAE and Europe. Services include private label, OEM and custom manufacturing with a low minimum order of 50 units per design.

Key facts:
- Location: Sialkot, Punjab, Pakistan
- Founded: 2017
- Minimum order quantity: 50 units per design
- Sample lead time: 5-7 days
- Production lead time: 3-4 weeks
- Monthly capacity: 10,000+ units
- Production methods: screen printing, embroidery, sublimation, heat transfer
- Export markets: United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Australia, UAE, European Union
- Shipping partners: DHL, FedEx, UPS
- Payment methods: bank transfer, PayPal, Western Union, Wise
- Business hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM PKT
- Response time: within 24 hours
- Email: rasheedclothingintl@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: +92 349 601 4611
- Audience: B2B (brands, retailers, teams and companies), not individual consumers

## Services
- [Private Label Clothing](https://www.rasheedclothingintl.me/private-label): Launch your own clothing brand with design support, low MOQ and fast sampling.
- [Custom Manufacturing](https://www.rasheedclothingintl.me/custom-manufacturing): OEM apparel production from tech pack to bulk delivery.
- [Customization and Printing](https://www.rasheedclothingintl.me/customization): Screen printing, embroidery, sublimation, custom labels and packaging.
- [Fabric Sourcing](https://www.rasheedclothingintl.me/fabrics): Fleece, jersey, French terry and performance fabrics.
- [Export Services](https://www.rasheedclothingintl.me/export-services): Documentation, packaging and worldwide shipping from Pakistan.

## Products
- [Products](https://www.rasheedclothingintl.me/products): Hoodies, tees, tracksuits, outerwear, gymwear and corporate uniforms.
- [Collections](https://www.rasheedclothingintl.me/collections): Apparel collections made to order.
- [Portfolio](https://www.rasheedclothingintl.me/portfolio): Garments produced for international clients.
- [Design Studio](https://www.rasheedclothingintl.me/design-studio): Design custom apparel online.
